name: MohawkBat
identity: Dark charcoal/olive-gray bat with ochre-gold patches, huge pointed ears, a three-point ochre-gold mohawk, cream eyes, ivory fangs, small golden piglike nose and two broad dark gray ribbed leathery wings. Compact torso with two tiny integrated dangling clawed feet, no tail.
visual_reference_notes: Observed source_prefab_offline.png: gold crest and patches, gray membranes with dark brown ribs, short feet on compact torso; do not invent a long tail or walking legs.
